Raw Egg Protein Smoothie Bowl Recipe [Paleo, Dairy-Free, High-Protein]
By: Paleo Flourish
Published: Monday, July 16, 2018 - 1:35am

Ingredients




1/2 avocado
0.5 oz almonds (approx. 10 almonds)
3/4 cup pineapple chunks, frozen
2 raw eggs
1/2 cup water
6 ice cubes

Preparation

1 Place all the ingredients into a blender. 2 Blend until it forms a creamy smoothie-like consistency.

About

DESCRIPTION: Get more protein into your diet with this raw egg smoothie bowl.
